title: r/longevity on Reddit: Is Quercetin an effective senolytic activator?
abstract:
/r/longevity is the place to find all information about new longevity, healthspan, happyspan, and rejuvenation research related news. ... Combined with Dasatinib I believe it’s the best readily available senolytic. By itself I think it’s useless. This is for personal experience. ... Here are some studies since 2000 with quercetin in the text and senolytic in the title. And vice versa. Basic understanding: Not much. Fisetin seems to be quite a bit better.
